resultEvidence.title: This Acti9 iC60N is a low voltage miniature circuit breaker (MCB). It is a 1P circuit breaker with 1 protected pole, 10A rated current and C tripping curve. The rated short circuit breaking capacity goes up to 10kA at 220VAC to 240VAC conforming to EN/IEC 60947-2 standard and 6000A at 230VAC conforming to EN/IEC 60898-1 standard. It complies with both industrial standard EN/IEC 60898-1 and residential standard EN/IEC 60947-2. This miniature circuit breaker protects circuits against short circuit and overload current. Its unique VisiTrip indicator reduces intervention time by showing the faulty circuit. Its VisiSafe green strip guarantees the physical opening of the contacts to allow downstream maintenance. Its fast closing mechanism independent of manual operation improves its service life. It has an electrical endurance going up to 10000 cycles and a mechanical endurance going up to 20000 cycles. The Ui rated insulation voltage is 500VAC. Its limitation class 3 (according to EN/IEC60898-1) improves downstream circuit protection cost. The product can be clipped on a DIN rail. Its width is 2 pitches of 9mm. Pollution degree is 3. Overvoltage category is IV. The product colour is white (RAL9003). The dimensions are (W) 18mm x (H) 85mm x (D) 78.5mm. The weight is 0.215kg. According to IEC 60529 standard, the degree of protection is IP20 and IP40 in enclosure. The operating temperature is -35°C to 70°C. The storage temperature is -40°C to 85°C.

resultEvidence.title: This Altistart 01 soft starter is DIN rail mounted and can feed 3-phase asynchronous motors with a rating up to 6A. This Altistart 01 can be used for a motor rated power up to 1.1kW or 1.5hp for 3-phase (200V to 240V AC). This DIN rail mounted soft starter is designed to enable smooth start for simple machines such as conveyors, conveyor belts, pumps, fans, compressors, automatic doors and gates, small cranes and belt-driven machinery. It is 45mm wide, this makes it one of the smallest soft starters on the market;  it can be installed nearly everywhere. It features an Integrated bypass, this reduces noise and decreases heat dissipation. Simple setup with only 2 settings: possible to configure by non-specialists. It provides smooth starting for your machinery, avoiding mechanical stresses and extending their service life.
